## Contribution of Authors {.unnumbered}

[Official McGill Guidelines](https://www.mcgill.ca/gps/thesis/thesis-guidelines/preparation):
A doctoral thesis must clearly state the elements of the thesis that are
considered original scholarship and distinct contributions to knowledge.

- Contributions of the student to each chapter must be explicitly stated.
- Contributions of any co-authors to each chapter must be explicitly stated.
